meaning: editor (a person who edits books, articles or videos)

senses.en: editor (a person who edits books, articles or videos)

examples.zh: 他是这本书的编辑。
examples.en: He is the editor of this book.

examples.zh: 请把文章给我们的编辑。
examples.en: Please send the article to our editor.

examples.zh: 你为什么想当编辑？
examples.en: Why do you want to become an editor?

meaning: to carve; to engrave

senses.en: to carve; to engrave

examples.zh: 他在木头上刻了一个字。
examples.en: He carved a character into the wood.

examples.zh: 这个名字是谁刻的？
examples.en: Who engraved this name?

examples.zh: 师傅正在石头上刻花。
examples.en: The craftsman is carving flowers into the stone.

meaning: fair; impartial

senses.en: fair; impartial

examples.zh: 法官的判断很公正。
examples.en: The judge's decision was very fair.

examples.zh: 老师对每个学生都很公正。
examples.en: The teacher is fair to every student.

examples.zh: 他们的处理方式不公正，大家都不满意。
examples.en: Their way of handling it was not fair, and everyone was unhappy.

meaning: at long last; finally (after a wait or effort)

senses.en: at long last; finally (after a wait or effort)

note: Signals relief: something hoped for has finally happened.

examples.zh: 等了三个月，签证总算办好了。
examples.en: After waiting three months, the visa is finally done.

examples.zh: 雨停了，我们总算可以出门了。
examples.en: The rain has stopped, so we can finally go out.

examples.zh: 孩子的烧总算退了。
examples.en: The child's fever has finally gone down.

meaning: ancient; very old

senses.en: ancient; very old

examples.zh: 这是一座古老的城市。
examples.en: This is an ancient city.

examples.zh: 我对这个古老的传统很感兴趣。
examples.en: I am very interested in this ancient tradition.

examples.zh: 这座桥看起来很古老。
examples.en: This bridge looks very old.

meaning: to entrust; to ask someone to act on your behalf

senses.en: to entrust; to ask someone to act on your behalf

examples.zh: 我委托朋友帮我取快递。
examples.en: I asked a friend to pick up my parcel for me.

examples.zh: 他委托律师处理这件事。
examples.en: He entrusted a lawyer with this matter.

examples.zh: 你可以委托别人替你去吗？
examples.en: Can you ask someone else to go in your place?

meaning: conflict; to clash (schedules, interests, people)

senses.en: conflict; to clash (schedules, interests, people)

examples.zh: 开会时间和出差时间冲突了。
examples.en: The meeting time clashes with my business trip.

examples.zh: 他们两个人因为钱发生了冲突。
examples.en: The two of them got into a conflict over money.

examples.zh: 我不想和家人发生冲突。
examples.en: I don't want to have a conflict with my family.

meaning: instructions; directive from a superior

senses.en: instructions; directive from a superior

note: Also a verb: to instruct. Often from a boss, doctor or authority.

examples.zh: 请按照医生的指示吃药。
examples.en: Please take the medicine as the doctor instructs.

examples.zh: 经理有什么新指示吗？
examples.en: Does the manager have any new instructions?

examples.zh: 我们没有收到上级的指示。
examples.en: We have not received instructions from above.

meaning: to hold; to grip; to shake (hands)

senses.en: to hold; to grip; to shake (hands)

examples.zh: 他紧紧地握着我的手。
examples.en: He held my hand tightly.

examples.zh: 见面时，他握住了我的手。
examples.en: When we met, he grasped my hand.

examples.zh: 你手里握着什么？
examples.en: What are you holding in your hand?

meaning: person of a certain group or field (formal)

senses.en: person of a certain group or field (formal)

note: Formal; used with a modifier: 专业人士 (professional), 有名人士 (public figure).

examples.zh: 会议邀请了很多专业人士。
examples.en: The conference invited many professionals.

examples.zh: 他是一位有名人士。
examples.en: He is a well-known public figure.

examples.zh: 有些人士说，下个月开始检查。
examples.en: Some people say inspections begin next month.

meaning: simply; might as well; (of a person) straightforward

senses.en: simply; might as well; (of a person) straightforward

examples.zh: 时间太晚了，我们干脆打车去吧。
examples.en: It's too late, so let's just take a taxi.

examples.zh: 你干脆把事情告诉他吧。
examples.en: You might as well just tell him everything.

examples.zh: 他回答得很干脆，没有犹豫。
examples.en: He answered very directly, without hesitating.

meaning: to mention; to bring up (a topic)

senses.en: to mention; to bring up (a topic)

examples.zh: 他很少提起过去的事。
examples.en: He rarely talks about the past.

examples.zh: 别在她面前提起这件事。
examples.en: Don't bring this up in front of her.

examples.zh: 你刚才提起的那本书叫什么？
examples.en: What is the book you just mentioned called?

meaning: to publish (books, magazines)

senses.en: to publish (books, magazines)

examples.zh: 这本书是去年出版的。
examples.en: This book was published last year.

examples.zh: 他的新书什么时候出版？
examples.en: When will his new book come out?

examples.zh: 这家公司每年出版很多书。
examples.en: This company publishes many books every year.

meaning: to be used for (doing something)

senses.en: to be used for (doing something)

note: Pattern: 用来 + verb, often 是用来……的.

examples.zh: 这个杯子是用来装茶的。
examples.en: This cup is used for holding tea.

examples.zh: 这笔钱是用来买房子的。
examples.en: This money is for buying a house.

examples.zh: 手机不只是用来打电话的。
examples.en: A phone is not only for making calls.

meaning: to lack; to be short of

senses.en: to lack; to be short of

examples.zh: 他缺乏工作经验。
examples.en: He lacks work experience.

examples.zh: 很多孩子缺乏运动。
examples.en: Many children don't get enough exercise.

examples.zh: 这个地方缺乏医生。
examples.en: This place is short of doctors.

meaning: to inherit; to carry on (a tradition, a business)

senses.en: to inherit; to carry on (a tradition, a business)

examples.zh: 他继承了父亲的生意。
examples.en: He took over his father's business.

examples.zh: 我们要继承好的传统。
examples.en: We should carry on good traditions.

examples.zh: 房子由谁继承？
examples.en: Who will inherit the house?

meaning: album (music); special collection

senses.en: album (music); special collection

examples.zh: 她的新专辑下个月出。
examples.en: Her new album comes out next month.

examples.zh: 我买了一张他的专辑。
examples.en: I bought one of his albums.

examples.zh: 这张专辑里有十首歌。
examples.en: There are ten songs on this album.

meaning: to dye; to catch (a disease or bad habit)

senses.en: to dye; to catch (a disease or bad habit)

examples.zh: 她把头发染成了黄色。
examples.en: She dyed her hair yellow.

examples.zh: 小心，别染上感冒。
examples.en: Be careful not to catch a cold.

examples.zh: 这件衣服是用植物染的吗？
examples.en: Was this garment dyed with plants?

meaning: suit (Western-style)

senses.en: suit (Western-style)

examples.zh: 面试的时候，他穿了一套西装。
examples.en: He wore a suit to the interview.

examples.zh: 这件西装多少钱？
examples.en: How much is this suit jacket?

examples.zh: 你的西装需要洗吗？
examples.en: Does your suit need cleaning?

meaning: to punish; to fine

senses.en: to punish; to fine

examples.zh: 他开车太快了，被罚了两百块。
examples.en: He drove too fast and got fined 200 yuan.

examples.zh: 老师不会罚学生站着。
examples.en: The teacher won't make students stand as punishment.

examples.zh: 迟到的人要罚吗？
examples.en: Will latecomers be penalized?
